summary: The absent-host debate: proposal 213 would count async engagement toward host pay; the town can now build a university.
Proposal 213 passes 37–11 and is applied; the town declares Snoopy the Just Day.
Proposal 221 falls 59–54 on the mayor-name question; today's schoolhouse workshop takes on contributor credit.
Stonervision's gallery bid fails 1-5 on Nimbus's dissent; Panda Park annexed; Amazon open-sources TorchNeuron; Japan's MMX lifts off for Phobos.
Proposal 253 passes 54-0: the town votes for a builders' toolkit standard, plus Gates on twenty tumultuous AI years and a muscle-powered swimming robot.
